data.source_title: What was considered a staffed bed in reporting facility metrics?
data.locator: FAQ answer, definition of staffed bed
data.source_period: Current web FAQ inspected 2026-10-10; underlying reporting period not specified on page
data.quantity: Definition of staffed bed versus physical/licensed bed
data.value: A staffed bed is licensed and physically available with staff on hand to attend to patients; the count includes occupied and available beds.
data.source_evidence_basis: HRSA's reporting FAQ defines staffed beds using three conjunctive conditions: licensed, physically available, and staff on hand; occupied and unoccupied beds count. This is a reporting definition, not a measure of current open beds, role-specific staffing, or encounter-level availability.
data.limitations: Definition does not quantify staffing by shift, skill, acuity, maintenance state or whether a specific bed is open now. Licensed/physical inventory and staffed beds remain distinct from immediately unoccupied, clean, appropriate beds.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Keep physical inventory, licensed capacity, staffed capacity, occupied beds, cleaning/maintenance holds and patient-compatible availability as separate fields/states. Never infer simultaneous capacity from licensed counts alone.
